context: Tests whether the agent follows the grill-me skill when stress-testing a design spec: correctly structures challenge questions with recommendations, covers all decision-branch categories, produces the required summary format, and avoids modifying input files.

checklist.name: No spec modification
checklist.description: The file inputs/spec.md is not modified — the agent must not alter the original artifact without being asked

checklist.name: Recommended answer per question
checklist.description: Every challenge question posed includes the agent's own recommended answer or suggested resolution (not just the question alone)

checklist.name: Questions posed individually
checklist.description: Challenge questions are structured one at a time (numbered or clearly separated individually), not bundled into compound multi-part questions

checklist.name: Unstated assumptions identified
checklist.description: At least one unstated assumption from the spec is called out (e.g. deduplication behavior, ordering guarantees, or backpressure handling)

checklist.name: Edge cases identified
checklist.description: At least one edge case or scenario not handled in the spec is identified (e.g. what happens when all channels fail, in-flight events during restart, or rate limits on delivery)

checklist.name: Missing alternatives identified
checklist.description: At least one area where the spec made a choice without discussing alternatives is surfaced (e.g. fallback channel strategy, at-least-once vs exactly-once delivery guarantee)

checklist.name: Decisions Made section
checklist.description: The report contains a section titled 'Decisions Made' (or equivalent heading) listing settled decisions

checklist.name: Decisions include reasons
checklist.description: Each item in the 'Decisions Made' section includes a reason or rationale, not just the decision label

checklist.name: Changes to Apply section
checklist.description: The report contains a section titled 'Changes to Apply' (or equivalent heading) listing concrete updates to make to the spec

checklist.name: Actionable change items
checklist.description: Each item in 'Changes to Apply' is a concrete, actionable change to the artifact (not vague like 'improve the spec')
